“But I really was a fool. There was no way a lie like that could hide the truth forever, but I still thought I could keep fooling you.

“I told myself it didn't matter that Grandfather's worms were living inside me. I thought that as long as I held fast to who I was, I could never lose to him——and then I lost just like that.

“…What he put on me then wasn't poison or anything like it. It was barely more than a suggestion. That alone was enough to make me lose myself and hurt you.”
